results.description:
iBend Pipe is the best conduit bending applicaiton on an iPhone, it helps you bend it right...the first time.  

It calculates the following bends using English or Metric measurements so you don’t have to:

    -Offsets Bends (specify towards an obstruction or away from an obstruction)
    -Rolling Offsets Bends  (specify towards an obstruction or away from an obstruction)
    -Parallel Offset Adjustment
    -3-Bend Saddles
    -4-Bend Saddles
    -Segment Bends
    -90° Bends
    -Back to Back 90° Bends
    -Kicked 90°s Bends
    -Compound 90° Bends around a Round Obstruction
    -Compound 90° Bends around a Square Obstruction
    -Compound 90° Bends around a Rectangular Obstruction

+ HOW DOES IT WORK?
Simply slide your finger to set measurements and results are updated instantly.  There is no need to navigate through multiple screens just to get a measurement.  Easy and intuitive to use, and measurement are displayed in big font to make it easy to read.

+FAST ONE SCREEN CALCULATIONS
Simple one screen calculations that show results "live" and on the fly as you slide your finger to enter values in.

+ACCURATE CALCULATIONS
Centerline bending radius - based calculations are also available.  These calculations offer greater accuracy when compared to bending multiplier methods.  Preposition your bends automatically.  All bends take shrink into account so you don't have to do any math.  What's faster - bending it twice or bending it right the first time?

+PROTRACTOR FUNCTION INCLUDED
Use the included protractor function to measure the angle as you bend.  Angle will be fed directly from your input screen to save you time.

+BENDER PROFILES
Almost 100 different bender/pipe combinations included.  You have the ability to tweak or completely modify any of the combinations to match your bender on the field.

+ WHO IS IT FOR?
If you consider yourself a craftsman that takes pride in his work, iBend Pipe is for you.  If other "sparkies" come to you when they have a difficult bend, this is for you.  If you want to have a smaller "bone"  pile, this is for you.  If you can write your name in conduit, this is for you.  From, a  1st year inside wireman apprentice to a seasoned “old timer” this app will save you time and material.

Input fractions instead of converting to decimals and get results in fractions.

Thanks for all the great reviews, if you have any suggestions:
support@ibendpipe.com

results.releaseNotes:
What's New in Version 6.5:

New benders:
We've added 195 new bender settings from the major brands:
• Milwaukee hand benders
• Greenlee 854DX, 855GX and 1818
• Current Tools 77, 254, 747 Omni, 750/751 and 797 IQ
• iTOOLco Rapid Fire
• Gardner Bender hand benders

They're added to your list automatically. Your existing benders, edits and favorites stay as they are.

Find the right bender faster
• The Benders list now has a Favorites / All / Filter switch at the top.
• Choose Filter to narrow the list by trade size, material and manufacturer. You can combine all three.
• The new Sort by Size button puts your whole list in order from smallest to largest pipe size, grouped by material and manufacturer. You can still drag benders into any order afterward.
• The switch stays pinned at the top while you scroll.
• A larger target for marking favorite benders.

Better on every iPhone, including iPhone SE and mini
• Calculation screens now fit small screens properly. Labels no longer run off the edge or overlap.
• When an input panel doesn't fit on a smaller iPhone, the screen now scrolls instead of shrinking the diagram. The picture stays full size and you can reach every control.
• Measurements and their names no longer overlap in the results.
• Bender cards, Settings and the Feedback screen now show their full text instead of cutting it off.

Easier to tap, even with gloves on
• Bigger buttons throughout the app: angle presets, ± buttons, keypad keys, list rows and the Level screen's close button.
• On the Level screen, tapping anywhere on a preset box now works, not just on the number. The ZERO button is also cleaner and centered.
• Taller angle selectors on the Three Bend screens.

Polish
• A more compact angle panel that takes up less room.
• Smoother panel animations on the Offset and Rolled Offset screens.
results.description:
iBend Pipe — Bend It Right the First Time

iBend Pipe is a professional conduit bending calculator designed to help electricians make accurate bends faster and reduce wasted material. Whether you're bending a simple offset or laying out a complex compound bend around an obstruction, iBend Pipe gives you the information you need to bend it right—the first time.



CONDUIT BENDING CALCULATORS

Calculate the following bends using English or Metric measurements:

• Offsets — bend toward or away from an obstruction  
• Rolling Offsets — bend toward or away from an obstruction  
• Parallel Offset Adjustments  
• 3-Bend Saddles  
• 4-Bend Saddles  
• Segmented Bends  
• 90° Bends  
• Back-to-Back 90° Bends  
• Kicked 90° Bends  
• Compound 90° Bends around round obstructions  
• Compound 90° Bends around square obstructions  
• Compound 90° Bends around rectangular obstructions  



FAST, ONE-SCREEN CALCULATIONS

Enter your measurements and see results update instantly. There’s no need to work through multiple screens just to get a measurement. iBend Pipe is designed to keep the calculation and results visible so you can work quickly and efficiently.

Large, easy-to-read measurements make the app practical to use on the job.



ACCURATE, PRACTICAL RESULTS

iBend Pipe goes beyond basic bending multipliers. Centerline bending radius calculations are available for greater accuracy, and bends automatically account for shrink so you don't have to do the math yourself.

Pre-position your bends, plan your layout, and get the information you need before you start bending.

What's faster—bending it twice or bending it right the first time?



PROTRACTOR INCLUDED

Use the built-in protractor to measure your bend angle as you bend. The measured angle can be sent directly back to your calculation, helping you work faster without switching between tools.



BENDER PROFILES

iBend Pipe includes nearly 100 bender and conduit combinations. You can also customize or modify profiles to match the benders and conduit you use in the field.



FRACTIONS, NOT JUST DECIMALS

Enter measurements as fractions instead of converting everything to decimals. Get your results in practical measurements you can use on the job.



BUILT FOR ELECTRICIANS

iBend Pipe is for the electrician who takes pride in their work.

If you're the person other electricians come to when they have a difficult bend, this app is for you. If you want less wasted conduit in the bone pile, this app is for you. If you can write your name in conduit, this app is definitely for you.

From a first-year apprentice to a seasoned journeyman, iBend Pipe is designed to save time, reduce wasted material, and make difficult conduit bends easier to plan.

Bend it right. The first time.

Thanks for all the great reviews! If you have questions or suggestions, contact me at:

support@ibendpipe.com
